output.summary: Annual herb native across most of the world, from Arctic to tropical regions, except South America and southern Africa. It has reddish stems with swollen joints, often dark-blotched leaves, and dense, often nodding spikes of tiny pink flowers. Remains were identified in the intestinal contents of Tollund Man in Denmark.
output.edibilityNote: Remains were found in Tollund Man’s intestinal contents in Denmark; the plant part and preparation are unspecified.
